questions.question: The training academy for Indian Police Service officers has been named after:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The training academy for Indian Police Service (IPS) officers is named the **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy**.
 
• It is located in **Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.
 
• The academy was named in honor of **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who is also known as the "Iron Man of India" for his role in the unification of India.
 
• The academy provides training to IPS officers before they are assigned to their respective cadres.
 
• It is an esteemed institution under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• He played a key role in India's independence movement and served as the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.
 
• Sardar Patel is remembered for his leadership in integrating over 500 princely states into the Indian Union post-independence.
 
• He was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 1991.
 
 
 
• **Indian Police Service (IPS)**
 
 
• The IPS is one of the three All India Services of the Government of India.
 
• It was formed in 1948, replacing the Indian Imperial Police.
 
• IPS officers are responsible for the enforcement of law and order, crime prevention, and investigation across the country.
 
 
 
• **Training at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel National Police Academy**
 
 
• The training program includes physical fitness, academic knowledge, law enforcement techniques, and leadership skills.
 
• The duration of the training program is around 46 weeks, which includes both indoor and outdoor training sessions.
 
• IPS probationers also undergo practical training in field conditions as part of their curriculum.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs**
 
 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) is a ministry of the Government of India, responsible for internal security and domestic policy.
 
• It oversees the Indian Police Service (IPS) and the training academies for the police forces.
 
• The current Minister of Home Affairs is Amit Shah (as of 2023).

questions.question: In which year was the first meeting of National Integration Council held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1962.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• National Integration Council was established in the **year 1961.**
 
• Its first meeting took place in 1962.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The National Integration Council was established by the then Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru to address the problems of communalism and regionalism in India. 
 
• The National Integration Council is an extra-constitutional body.
 
• The Prime Minister is the chairman of the council.
 
• The function of the council is to examine the problem of national integration in every aspect and make necessary recommendations to deal with it.

questions.question: The Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM) was established in the year _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1948**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM) was established in the year **1948**.
 
• IBM functions under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in the conservation and scientific development of mineral resources.
 
• IBM is responsible for the regulation and development of the mining sector in India, including the inspection of mines and the promotion of sustainable mining practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions of IBM:**

 
 
• IBM conducts mineral resource surveys and exploration programs.
 
• It provides technical consultancy services for the mining industry.
 
• IBM plays a significant role in the preparation and implementation of mining policies and regulations.
 
 
 
• **IBM's Role in Sustainable Mining:**
 
 
• IBM promotes sustainable mining practices to minimize environmental impact.
 
• It ensures the proper reclamation of mined areas for future use.
 
• IBM also oversees the implementation of safety standards in mines to protect workers.
 
 
 
• **IBM Publications:**
 
 
• IBM publishes various reports, statistics, and guidelines related to the mining sector.
 
• These publications are valuable resources for stakeholders in the mining industry.
 
 
 
• **Training and Development:**
 
 
• IBM conducts training programs for mining professionals to enhance their skills and knowledge.
 
• It collaborates with educational institutions for research and development in the field of mining.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the National Archives of India established?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1891.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The** National Archives of India** is **established **on** 11 March 1891 at Calcutta (Kolkata).**
 
• It is the custodian of the records of the enduring value of the Government of India.
 
• It is the Imperial Record Department, which is the biggest archival repository in South Asia.
 
• It is under the Ministry of Culture.
 
• It provides financial assistance to State/Union Territories.
 
• It has a regional office in Bhopal and record centres in Jaipur, Pondicherry, and Bhubaneswar.
 
• It is the **Central Repository of non-current records of enduring value belonging to**:
 
 
• Ministries and Departments of the Government of India.
 
• Private papers of eminent Indians.
 
• Microfilm copies of records of Indian interests from abroad.

questions.question: Nalanda University, an important centre in ancient period is situated in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nalanda University:-**

 
 
• It is considered as the world's first residential university and among the greatest centers of learning in the ancient world.
 
• **It was located near the city of Rajagriha (now Rajgir) and about 90 kilometres (56 mi) southeast of Pataliputra (now Patna).**
 
• Nalanda was founded in the 5th century CE and flourished for over 700 years, attracting scholars and students from all over Asia.
 
• It was a major center for the study of Buddhism, as well as other subjects such as philosophy, logic, mathematics, astronomy, and medicine.
 
• **The university was destroyed by the invading armies of Bakhtiyar Khilji in 1200 CE, but it remains an important symbol of India's rich cultural heritage.**
 
• In 2010, a new Nalanda University was established in Rajgir, near the site of the ancient university. The new university is an international and research-intensive university that offers postgraduate programs in a variety of disciplines. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar:-**

 
 
• It is a state in eastern India.
 
• It is the third largest state by population, the 12th largest by area, and the 14th largest by GDP in 2021.
 
• Bihar borders Uttar Pradesh to its west, Nepal to the north, the northern part of West Bengal to the east, and Jharkhand to the south.

questions.question: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) is a statutory multi-disciplinary body under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC). Its headquarters are in:
Which of the following is the zonal headquarter of North Eastern Railway?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gorakhpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gorakhpur** serves as the **zonal headquarters** of the **North Eastern Railway** (NER).
 
• It is located in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**, India.
 
• The **North Eastern Railway** is one of the **17 railway zones** of Indian Railways.
 
• The NER operates across multiple states including **Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Uttarakhand**, providing essential connectivity to these regions.
 
• Gorakhpur is home to the **world’s longest railway platform**, which spans a length of **1,366.33 meters**.
 
• The NER zone plays a crucial role in **passenger and freight transport**, supporting the economy and mobility in North India.
 
• The zone has a significant historical legacy, being established in **1952**, and continues to contribute to the development of the Indian Railways network.
 
• Gorakhpur has modern facilities and infrastructure to manage the operations of the North Eastern Railway efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Allahabad (Now Prayagraj)**__

 __
 
• Allahabad, renamed **Prayagraj**, is the headquarters of the **North Central Railway (NCR)** zone.
 
• The NCR zone covers parts of **Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Haryana**.
 
• Prayagraj is an important historical and cultural city but is not associated with the North Eastern Railway zone.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 __
 
• Kolkata is the headquarters of the **Eastern Railway (ER)** and the **South Eastern Railway (SER)** zones.
 
• The **Eastern Railway** primarily covers areas in **West Bengal, Bihar, and Jharkhand**.
 
• The city is also a hub for several other divisions of Indian Railways but does not serve as the headquarters for the North Eastern Railway.
 
 
 
• **Hubli**__
 
 
• Hubli, located in the state of **Karnataka**, is the headquarters of the **South Western Railway (SWR)** zone.
 
• The SWR zone primarily serves regions in **Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Goa, and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is unrelated to the operations of the North Eastern Railway.

questions.question: Which state in India houses The National Institute of Water Sports?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1990**, the** Ministry of Tourism, Government of India**, established the National Institute of Water Sports in **Goa **as the apex institution for recreational **watersports and aqua-tourism** in India.
 
• There is only **one** such institution in the country, and it is run by the** government, both central and state.**
 
• It has been designated as a center within the **Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management (IITTM)** and functions as such as a result of a Government order issued in** 2004.****​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 
 Goa is the** smallest state **in India. Covering an** area of 1,429 square miles**, it has a coastline that stretches for **99 miles.**
 
 
• In** 1524**, the Portuguese captain **Vasco da Gama** landed in Goa. More Portuguese arrived in 1510, looking to gain control of the spice root from the East, and two years later Goa became a Portuguese colony.
 
• India became an independent country, free from British rule, on 15th August 1947, but the Portuguese refused to release control of Goa. On **18th December 1961,** the Portuguese governor officially surrendered, and the next day, Goa officially became a part of India. Goa celebrates this **second independence day on 19th December **every year.
 
• The** Dudhsagar Waterfalls** can be found in the far east of the Goa state and is recognized as the** second-highest waterfall** in the whole of India, measuring** 603 meters tall.**
 
• Some of the **oldest rocks** in India are found in Goa between **Molem and Anmod.** Classified as **Trondjemeitic Gneiss**, these rocks are over** 3,600 million years old.**

questions.question: Who among the following is the co-founder of Darpana Academy of Performing Arts?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The co-founder of the **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts is Mrinalini Sarabhai.**
 
• **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts** is an institution in India that focuses on training in **various art forms, including dance, theatre, music, and puppetry.**
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai and her husband, Vikram Sarabhai,** founded the **Academy in 1949 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.**
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who dedicated her life to the promotion and preservation of traditional Indian art forms.
 
• **She was born on May 11, 1918, in Kerala**, India, and began her training in **Bharatanatyam, a form of classical Indian dance, at a young age.**
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai** is one of the foremost personalities in Indian classical dance. She was trained in Bharatnatyam, Kathakali.
 
• She performed extensively both in India and abroad and was the recipient of many awards and honours, **including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan, two of India's highest civilian honors.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pt Birju Maharaj **is an **Indian classical dancer and choreographer, known for his Kathak performances and contribution to the art form.**
 
• **Uday Shankar** was an** Indian dancer and choreographer, considered as the father of modern Indian dance and known for blending Indian classical dance with Western ballet.**
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai and Mrinalini Sarabhai** are both** Indian classical dancers and choreographers, with Mallika specializing in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi, and Mrinalini in Bharatanatyam and Kathakali.**
 
 
• **Both have also been involved in social activism and cultural education.**

questions.question: The Planning Commission was established by an executive decision of Government of India in ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Planning Commission of India was established on the year 15th March 1950.
 
• The Prime Minister is the ex-officio Chairman of this Commission.
 
• There is no provision for (or mention of) the Planning Commission in the Constitution of India.
 
• It was constituted in the form of an advisory and specialist institution.
 
• It was constituted by the Union Cabinet on the proposal of a member of the Union Parliament.
 
• The government has changed its organization and structure from time to time.
 
• Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Chairman of the Planning Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog Replaces Planning Commission: NITI (National Institution for Transforming India). It replaced Planning Commission in 2015 after 65 years by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• The National establishment for the reworking Republic of India, conjointly known as NITI Aayog, was fashioned via a resolution of the Union cupboard on Jan one, 2015.
 
• NITI Aayog is the premier policy ‘Think Tank’ of the govt of the Republic of India, providing each directional and policy input. Whereas coming up with strategic and long-run policies and programs for the Govt of the Republic of India, NITI Aayog conjointly provides relevant technical recommendations to the Centre and States.
 
• NITI Aayog Chairperson: Narendra Modi.
 
• NITI Aayog Headquarters: New Delhi.
